_comment: Top: Orbbec Gemini AY6V16300WC color. Dual xArm: Robot1 image bottom-LEFT true≈(-0.45,-0.35); Robot2 image bottom-RIGHT mirrored about image vertical through table_xy_affine → true≈(-0.55,+0.51). Do NOT use naive (+0.45,-0.35) — affine rotates axes ~90°. K and affine are still from the previous camera.

camera._comment: Orbbec Gemini colour node (the by-id symlink is the IR node: do not use). Checkerboard-calibrated 2026-11-16.

wrist_camera._comment: Orbbec Gemini 305 CV2L761000Z8 color, wrist. USB port 1.1.4 interface 1.4. by-id does not link this color node.

object_top_z_m._comment: Visible top-face height (m) for pixel projection. Not gripper z. Unmatched names use object_top_z_m_default.

grasp_height_offset_m._comment: Global (all EEs): added to grasp_height_m when object name contains the key. Negative = lower. Key stand also matches ring.

grasp_height_offset_by_ee._comment: Extra grasp z offsets applied only when that EE executes Grasp/Place (solver). parallel_gripper uses global only.

place_height_offset_m._comment: When Place destination is a named object matching the key: z = support.grasp_z + offset (stacks accumulate). stand=+0.03 per layer; container=+0.04 above support. Per-arm overrides: execution_by_arm.*.place_height_offset_m

overlap_xy._policy: Mutex: only one arm may occupy overlap. Same arm may keep working in-zone (Grasp then Place) without retracting. The lock stays held while that arm's last pose is still inside overlap. When the other arm needs the zone, retract the occupant to its exclusive workspace first, then transfer the lock.

xarm2._role: Robot2 LeapHand @ 192.168.2.199. Image bottom-RIGHT = mirror of Robot1 about image vertical; after table_xy_affine (~90°), true-table base ≈ (-0.55,+0.51) NOT (+0.45,-0.35).

robot._comment: Legacy single-arm field (Robot1). Prefer robots{} for multi-arm.

execution._comment: Legacy Robot1-only block. Multi-arm runners should read execution_by_arm.
execution._height_note: Measured 2026-08-08: STOP at grasp → base z≈200 mm. tip_z_base = table_z_base_m + grasp_height_m.

xarm._yaw_note: Object long-axis yaw + 0 so parallel jaws close across the short axis. +pi/2 made jaws align along the screw (2026-09-11).

grasp_height_offset_m._comment: arm1 parallel gripper: grasp screw 1cm lower than global.

place_height_offset_m._comment: arm1 parallel gripper: place onto stand 1cm lower than the previous +0.04.

xarm2._note: xarm2 residual refit 2026-11-17 from 11 samples (translation only, RMSE ~21 mm, LOO ~23 mm). Noise is dominated by alignment (high hover, oblique view, mixed targets); redo with low hover + one rigid box to tighten.
xarm2._yaw_note: LeapHand thumb-middle pinch across the short axis (perpendicular to object long edge). Unset offset defaulted to +pi/2 and aligned fingers along the long edge.

grasp_height_offset_m._comment: arm2 LeapHand extras on top of perception z. stand/ring 0.18-0.02=0.16; box 0.20-0.04=0.16. stand also matches ring. plush/bear 0.20-0.04=0.16 (worked 2026-11-17 11:35; 0.21 was too high).

xarm2._note_base_2026_11_16: Re-expressed through the new xarm1 global affine (true frame). Still an estimate (+-3 cm); the xarm2 residual fit corrects it.

table_xy_affine._comment: true_table = A @ pred_table + b (metres). pred = global table_xy_affine(raw). Translation-only residual: with 11 noisy samples a full affine had the same leave-one-out error (23.3 mm) and extrapolates worse.

_full_affine_fit_6pt._comment: true_table = A @ pred_table + b (metres). pred = global table_xy_affine(raw); per-arm residual.

xarm2._ee_center_note: measured by measure_hand_center (yaws 0,90,-90 deg, residual [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] mm). Flange is moved by -(R(yaw)-I)v.

_full_affine_fit_11pt._comment: true_table = A @ pred_table + b (metres). pred = global table_xy_affine(raw); per-arm residual.

leaphand._comment: LEAP MCP flat open = π (higher=curl). MCP 1/5 forced to π (no raw offset). Only joint 6 uses measured_open_raw. Open ramps present→π over open_duration_s.

measured_open_raw._comment: Do NOT set 1/5 here (code strips them → π). Joint 6 measured open only.

leaphand._comment_manual_poses: open_leap/close_leap: taught 16-DOF LEAP poses. When both set, open()/close() use them directly (skip formula thumb scales).

table_xy_affine._comment: true_table = A @ pred_table + b (metres). pred = to_table(uv, z=object_top).

_calibration.note: global table_xy_affine removed; per-arm residuals in execution_by_arm are stale until re-fit with calibrate_table_xy.py
_calibration.table_frame: x = xArm1 base X, y = -xArm1 base Y (matches flip_y=true), z up (left-handed); origin set so the xArm1 base plate is at (-0.45,-0.35). Axes/origin come from ONE eyeballed tip observation (xarm1 at base (286.3,-436.5,280)) + plate pixel -> expect a few cm / degrees; the arm affine refit corrects it.

table_xy_affine._comment: true_table = A @ pred_table + b (metres). pred = to_table(uv, z=object_top).
